rv.q: For an intelligent, funny, and genuinely affecting night at the theater, this world premiere is a gem.

"A Black-billed Cuckoo" is the 13th play to make the jump from the Playhouse's DNA New Work Series to a full production. It's a gentle and rewarding play about friendship, found family and starting over.
Butler makes the most of the 90-minute runtime with a tale about connection and coming to terms with tragedy.

cn.t: Critics embrace this bighearted world premiere comedy-drama about a Brooklyn birdwatching group, praising Mat Smart's sweet, surprising script packed with humor and emotional depth.
